boards.title: 10 Blocks Off Campus, One Reason Each
boards.description: Ten named public destinations along the Route 417, North Union Street, and East State Street corridors linking campus with Allegany and Olean.

cards.title: A paved river loop
cards.subtitle: Route 417 corridor beside campus
cards.notes: Use the campus-side trail access for a walk, run, or bike ride; plan your turnaround before leaving so the route fits your available time.
cards.short_summary: A paved looped trail along the Allegheny River that returns to campus.
cards.evidence_claim: St. Bonaventure identifies the Allegheny River Valley Trail as a 5.6-mile paved walking, jogging, and biking loop that runs through Olean and Allegany before returning to campus.
cards.access_notes: Use the trail only in conditions appropriate for walking or cycling; observe posted trail rules.

cards.title: A library stop in the village
cards.subtitle: West Main Street corridor, Allegany
cards.notes: Bring a current reading or research question and ask at the desk about materials, digital resources, or upcoming community programming.
cards.short_summary: The village library at 90 West Main Street.
cards.evidence_claim: Allegany Public Library lists its address as 90 W. Main Street in Allegany and provides e-resources and research access.
cards.access_notes: Check the library’s current calendar and policies before visiting.

cards.title: A recreation-center landmark
cards.subtitle: North 4th Street corridor, Allegany
cards.notes: Check the recreation department’s current offerings or reservation process before making plans around the gym or youth recreation center.
cards.short_summary: A municipal recreation complex with a youth recreation center.
cards.evidence_claim: The Town and Village of Allegany says its Recreation Department operates a Youth Recreation Center at the Fourth & Maple Complex.
cards.access_notes: Programs, reservations, and building access are administered by Allegany Recreation.

cards.title: An 18-hole disc-golf course
cards.subtitle: Gargoyle Road off West State Street
cards.notes: Pack a disc and use the city’s listing to orient yourself; keep to the marked course and check whether a scheduled event affects access.
cards.short_summary: A 49-acre park off West State Street with an 18-hole disc-golf course.
cards.evidence_claim: The City of Olean lists Gargoyle Park at 101 Gargoyle Road off West State Street and identifies its 18-hole disc-golf course.
cards.access_notes: The city notes summer rental use; confirm availability before a group visit.

cards.title: A compact court-and-playground stop
cards.subtitle: North Union Street Extension corridor, Olean
cards.notes: Use this as a short outdoor stop when traveling the North Union corridor; respect the smoke-free playground designation and other posted rules.
cards.short_summary: A 3.59-acre park with playground equipment and a paved basketball court.
cards.evidence_claim: The City of Olean lists Boardman Park on North Union Street Extension with playground equipment and a paved basketball court.
cards.access_notes: The city designates the playground area smoke-free.

cards.title: A playful downtown trailhead
cards.subtitle: Whitney Avenue off North Union Street, Olean
cards.notes: Stop for the outdoor ping-pong table, glow swing, or sound features while passing through downtown; bring what you need for an active visit.
cards.short_summary: A downtown parklet with interactive play and recreation features.
cards.evidence_claim: The City of Olean lists the Whitney Trailhead Parklet on Whitney Avenue off North Union Street with a glow swing, outdoor ping-pong table, climbing wall, and musical features.
cards.access_notes: The city designates the playground area smoke-free.

cards.title: A gazebo on the State–Union corner
cards.subtitle: East State Street and North Union Street corridor, Olean
cards.notes: Check the municipal calendar for public activities, then use the gazebo and monuments as a short walking destination in the downtown grid.
cards.short_summary: A corner park with a gazebo, monuments, and seasonal concert use.
cards.evidence_claim: The City of Olean lists Lincoln Park at State and Union streets, with a gazebo used for summer concerts and monuments in the park.
cards.access_notes: The gazebo is smoke-free and may be reserved for events.

cards.title: A lit field complex
cards.subtitle: East State Street and Front Street corridor, Olean
cards.notes: Look for scheduled public games or events before heading over; treat the facility as an event destination rather than entering restricted field areas.
cards.short_summary: A city stadium with football and baseball fields, lighting, and seating.
cards.evidence_claim: The City of Olean lists Bradner Stadium at East State and Front streets with football and baseball fields, night lighting, and seating for 4,000.
cards.access_notes: Facility rentals and event access vary; verify the schedule before visiting.

cards.title: A recreation-center anchor
cards.subtitle: East State Street and Front Street corridor, Olean
cards.notes: Pair a stop here with an East State Street walk, and check with the city before relying on pavilion or recreation-center access.
cards.short_summary: A 9.28-acre park with an accessible playground, volleyball court, pavilion, and recreation center.
cards.evidence_claim: The City of Olean lists War Vets Park at East State and Front streets and identifies the Olean Recreation Center, an accessible playground, volleyball court, and pavilion there.
cards.access_notes: Pavilion rentals are administered by the city; confirm availability for organized use.

cards.title: Disc golf with a fitness trail
cards.subtitle: Franchot Boulevard off South Union Street, Olean
cards.notes: Choose either the disc-golf course or fitness and jogging trail for a focused visit, and review posted site rules before using amenities.
cards.short_summary: A park with a 9-hole disc-golf course, fitness trail, jogging trail, courts, and fields.
cards.evidence_claim: The City of Olean lists Franchot Park off South Union Street with a 9-hole disc-golf course, fitness trail, jogging trail, basketball court, and athletic fields.
cards.access_notes: Some amenities and rentals are seasonal; check with the city for current access.
